static_review.review_scope: Static explicit 856 -> 863 hair-v2 -> 868 v1 -> 873 v1 -> 880 v1 source/draft group; no actual composite or original-speed acceptance

overall.verdict: Useful independent pose drafts, still unaccepted due to hair/costume/contour continuity risks. No final motion or compositor pass is established.

per_frame.role: Existing unaccepted preceding anchor, not repaired in this task
per_frame.observed: Closed eyes and a tall narrow open mouth; both open gloves point upward with forward palms. Screen-left leg extends down and foreground; screen-right leg folds back with the boot to its right. Exactly two hands and two leg chains visible.
per_frame.costume_state: Vertical center seam continues into the cream hem; clover sits toward screen-right of the coat; plain red shorts lack the narrow cream thigh bands introduced at f863. Wide multi-lobed collar and rounded side ponytails.
per_frame.limitations: Already-unaccepted anchor means copying its costume details is not approval of them.

per_frame.source_change: Higher frontal head and small O; both wrists turn from upright open palms to thin outward edge-on fingers; folded rear leg draws slightly inward.
per_frame.draft_observed: Both gloves now form horizontal side-facing silhouettes, not retained f856 upright palms. Frontal closed eyes and the smaller O are present. Two separate leg chains connect beneath the shorts; long front/down leg hides the medial root of the folded leg. The short side ponies end near the shoulders, and the previous overlong back-hair shape is absent in this explicit hair-v2.
risks: Center seam disappears despite another mostly frontal view; clover moves to the coat center and is smaller.
Hem changes to two rounded split/scalloped lobes and cream bands are introduced below both red shorts legs.
Pony tie/root identity and collar contour are still stylized rather than anatomically registered.

per_frame.source_change: Both palms reopen with thumbs up; frontal head tilts slightly, O grows vertically; rear leg foreshortens to a compact tucked knee and small shoe below it.
per_frame.draft_observed: Exactly two splayed brown gloves with upward thumbs; closed eyes, larger vertical O and two legs retained. Rear knee and boot are compact instead of copying the long far shin from the prior draft.
risks: Additional long blonde fans reappear behind both upper sleeves, extending far below the two cheek-side short ponies. Their roots are obscured and do not preserve the bounded f863 hair-v2 topology.
Rear boot remains farther screen-right and more exposed than the source's tightly tucked shoe; foreshortening/depth is approximate.

Collar becomes two smooth leaf-like lobes; clover becomes conspicuously larger; hem becomes one broad curved band; cream shorts-leg bands disappear. These are schema changes, not just pose deformation.

per_frame.source_change: Major independent extreme: body/head move right and lean clockwise; screen-left arm lifts steeply, screen-right arm lowers; formerly tucked leg unfolds into a long down-right kick with the sole edge visible.
per_frame.draft_observed: Asymmetric high-left/low-right arms and both visible open gloves are present. Closed eyelids and tilted smaller O remain. Exactly two long separated leg chains; down-left boot and raised down-right kicking boot are correctly distinct, with a readable sole edge on the kicking boot. This is not a rigid transform or alias of f868.
risks: Collar changes back to a multi-lobed scallop; coat hem again splits/scallops; thin cream shorts bands return.
Coat clover shrinks again and follows a different front-center placement from the f868 motif.
Backpack strap widths/side panels and pony-tip volume differ; exact boot depth and body contour still need motion/composite inspection.

per_frame.source_change: Raised arm approaches vertical; low-right hand descends; head leans further clockwise and O becomes smaller; the kicking second boot lowers into the caption band while the other leg remains down.
per_frame.draft_observed: High-left glove is nearly vertical above the head, low-right glove is lower, and both are visible. Two long separated legs remain; the right boot lowers and its sole-facing angle becomes shallower instead of staying at the f873 raised kick. Both closed eyes and smaller O remain.
risks: Small pale wedges appear behind the raised sleeve and beneath the lowering sleeve. They are not hand-shaped and no extra hand is confirmed, but their connection to the two short pony roots is not traced convincingly. They must be judged as hair/occlusion continuity, not automatically as retained yellow effects.
Source head/eyelid/mouth clockwise progression is stronger than the visually approximate draft progression; avoid claiming an exact head rotation match.
Multi-lobed collar, split hem and cream shorts bands persist from f873 but do not reconcile f856/f863/f868 costume changes.
Both boots enter opposite ends of the fixed caption area in the source; generated underlay alone cannot certify registered text occlusion or pale-on-pale contrast.

prioritized_findings.finding: Hair topology is not continuous after the f863 shortening: f868 introduces large rear fans; f880 adds weakly rooted pale wedges behind the sleeves.
prioritized_findings.constraint: Keep exactly two short side ponytails, attached through recognizable same-side roots; no extra long rear-hair fans. Draw sleeve-over-hair/strap occlusion explicitly. Preserve each current source hand and arm pose while repairing hair.

prioritized_findings.finding: Center seam, collar-lobe schema, split-vs-one-piece hem, shorts cream bands and coat-clover placement/size toggle between neighbors.
prioritized_findings.constraint: Choose one reviewed coat/shorts/collar schema before a bounded repair. Keep the same seam presence, collar topology, hem construction and clover motif as local cloth features that deform with perspective, not different garment designs. Do not call a costume repair pixel-locked without measuring drift.

prioritized_findings.finding: Gross two-leg trajectory is represented but f868 rear boot depth and subsequent soles/cuff outlines are approximate; f880 head tilt is not exact.
prioritized_findings.constraint: Retain two separate leg chains with the correct foreground medial overlap at f868; unfold the same tucked leg at f873, then lower that boot at f880. Match the current head/eyelid/mouth lean independently. Inspect actual sequential composites before acceptance.

limitations: Native-normalized generated images are not actual source-resolved output composites.
Static silhouette comparisons do not verify exposure timing or full-speed motion.
Source stars, yellow sparkle drawings and captions also appear in full-frame contours; not every edge is character anatomy.
